items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1958-05-24
items.q: The best I heard was a little son of Joseph Phillips. He's in Pacific, Florida. He got off this guy on Bay 5. He was about the best I heard around my time.

ctx.x: but did you know many guys that just pick blues guitar around the family
